verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led immigration and startup law firm. Legal-services providers can plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. Its stated posture favors accountable attorneys over automated legal tools, and the only intake is a short case-assessment form.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
